bootstrap.cluster: canonical pair within dataset, carrying all original seed records
bootstrap.seen1: filter per-seed seen1 after mapping common full-dataset pair multiplicities
bootstrap.selection: exact floor quota recomputed at each bootstrap replicate, with duplicate multiplicities split only at quota boundary
bootstrap.aggregation: geometric mean of three seed-level selected mean-loss ratios
bootstrap.interval: pointwise percentile 95%; secondary outcomes are supporting analyses, not additional independent confirmations
